summary.text: Your MediShield Life Premium Subsidy eligibility is generally valid for one year. It may be updated if your household information changes.

details.heading: Validity period
details.body: In general, your subsidy eligibility is valid for one year.

details.heading: When it may change
details.body: Your eligibility may be updated when your household information changes, such as when there is a new-born in your household.
